bio.text: Steve St. Clair is a Republican member of the Alaska House of Representatives for District 26; the Legislature's page lists his oath as taken December 30, 2025.

According to his legislative biography, he was born and raised in Washington State, served 20 years in the U.S. Army including a 2004 deployment to Afghanistan, and retired in 2010 as a first sergeant.
The biography says he earned a B.S. and an MBA from Touro University International, joined the Legislature as staff to Rep. Cathy Tilton in 2017, and was chief of staff to Rep. Thomas Baker in 2023.
